# AI Base

> A free, structured knowledge base for learning AI — 10 subjects, 624 topics, each with a worked example and a running interactive demo. MIT licensed, no tracking, no ads.

- [AI Fundamentals](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/fundamentals/): What AI is, and how an intelligent system perceives, decides and acts.
- [Math](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/math/): The language of models, from arithmetic to vectors, calculus, probability, statistics, information theory and attention.
- [Machine Learning](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/machine-learning/): Systems that learn patterns from data instead of being handed every rule: datasets, models, evaluation and the classic algorithms.
- [Deep Learning](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/deep-learning/): Multi-layer neural networks that learn useful representations themselves.
- [Neural Networks](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/neural-networks/): Neural computing beyond backpropagation: energy-based memory, biological inspiration, and architectures time passed by.
- [Transformers](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/transformers/): The architecture behind modern generative models: how attention becomes a full block, scales, and specializes.
- [Generative AI](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/generative-ai/): AI that creates new text, images, audio, video and code: decoding, conditioning, evaluation and the risks of generation itself.
- [LLMs](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/llms/): Transformers that predict the next token, over and over: how they're trained into instruction-followers, how they reason, and how the field around them works.
- [RAG](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/rag/): Retrieval-augmented generation: grounding a model in real documents, from chunking and embeddings to retrieval, generation and evaluation.
- [Agents](https://ai.saranmahadev.in/agents/): Systems that perceive, decide and act using everything before them: planning, tool use, memory, multi-agent coordination, evaluation and safety.

## Reference
